title: Four-query input-consistency tester
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input bits. Its four-query input-consistency tester is obtained by padding the three-query input-consistency tester with one query, and has addresses in the disjoint union of input positions and quadratic PCPP proof positions.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
